payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate through string, maintain a hash map from prefix sums to per-letter occurrence counts. For each position, add count of previous positions with same prefix sum and same letter, then update map.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a dictionary mapping prefix sums to 26-element lists, which is a classic hash map application. No recurrence or DP states are defined; the core is O(1) map lookups and updates. Family data_structures fits exactly.
